verdict.rationale: The pricing page confirms Sentry ships custom dashboards (10 on one tier, 20 on another), and Releases docs exist, so a dashboarding surface for error data is evidenced. Nothing describes what those dashboards show or whether they meet the story's specific needs. Missing for 10: evidence of cross-project/team aggregation, top-regression views, new-issues-per-release breakdowns, error volume-over-time widgets, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
